_note: Varicap (tuning) diode: a silicon junction used reverse-biased, its capacitance falling as the reverse voltage rises. 2-terminal: anode, cathode. Engine (bw-board varicap): a diode whose junction capacitance cjo/(1+Vr/vj)^m the RF network sees (defaults cjo 40 pF, vj 0.7 V, m 0.5; named part BB910). Leads four columns apart, like a diode.
